name: Power Resistance
body:
Discipline clairsentience; Level psion/wilder 5, tactician 5

MANIFESTING

Display Material and visual
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Touch
Target Creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Power Resistance Yes (harmless)
Power Points 9

DESCRIPTION

The creature gains power resistance equal to 12 + your manifester level.
